verified: Names, descriptions and grades cross-checked live 19 Nov 2026 against Exophase (exophase.com/game/grand-theft-auto-vi-psn/trophies) and PSNProfiles (psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi): all 55 agree, in the same order. PSN progress targets (0/N) are from PSNProfiles. 28 trophies are hidden on PlayStation until earned.
sources_note: Every guide below is written in our own words for this entry. Facts drawn from a launch-day guide name that guide in the trophy's sources field; where no source pins a place or method down, the guide says so plainly instead of inventing one.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this pops automatically — there is nothing extra to do. Work the roadmap in order: story first, side stories next, then partner and crime trophies, activities and collectibles, money, and finally 100% completion. Keep the chapter saves the roadmap asks for, so one missed moment never costs a second playthrough.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. Roadmap: built from the official descriptions.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first mission of the game and cannot be missed — finish it and the trophy pops. No preparation and no side requirement; just play the story from the start.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. No outside method needed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 in full. Chapter trophies can pop as the next chapter begins rather than on the last cutscene, so keep playing into Chapter 2 if it has not popped yet. Unmissable in any playthrough that finishes the story. Before Chapter 1 ends, do Lucia's balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude — that one can be missed.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. Chapter-pop timing and the Chapter 1 warning: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 in full. Switching between Jason and Lucia should open up during this chapter, and most of the list opens up once both are playable — use Chapter 2 to sample activities and meet the side characters. Unmissable in any playthrough that finishes the story.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. Character switching in Chapter 2: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 in full. Do the time-sensitive race 'Race Against Yago' in Yago's street-racing strand the moment it appears — it carries an hourglass icon and counts toward Strangers & Freaks. Save first, then race. The chapter trophy itself is unmissable.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. Yago race warning: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 in full. Bank-vault robberies unlock through an optional mission near the end of this chapter, so Chapter 4 is where the crime trophies start opening up. The chapter trophy itself is unmissable.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. Vault unlock timing: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. Keep a manual save from just before it — there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so that save lets you replay the ending freely afterwards. Unmissable in any playthrough that finishes the story.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. No mission replay / save advice: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks as the story reaches it; play the story in order and the trophy pops on completion. Nothing to prepare and nothing that can be missed.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. No outside method needed.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. It unlocks as the story reaches it; play the story in order and the trophy pops on completion. Nothing to prepare and nothing that can be missed.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. No outside method needed.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. It unlocks as the story reaches it; play the story in order and the trophy pops on completion. Nothing to prepare and nothing that can be missed.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. No outside method needed.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. It unlocks as the story reaches it; play the story in order and the trophy pops on completion. Nothing to prepare and nothing that can be missed.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. No outside method needed.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. It unlocks as the story reaches it; play the story in order and the trophy pops on completion. Nothing to prepare and nothing that can be missed.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. No outside method needed.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It unlocks as the story reaches it; play the story in order and the trophy pops on completion. Nothing to prepare and nothing that can be missed.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. No outside method needed.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The in-game checklist (Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion — it appears after the story) tracks it, and work you do before the story ends still counts. It is the long grind behind the platinum: story, side stories, activities, collectibles and the counts on the other trophies all feed it. Check the checklist, not your memory, before you call a category done.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. PSN target 0/100. Checklist location: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts. Stunt jumps, under-the-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250. Stunts are free-roam, so grind them anywhere after the story — or a few at a time while travelling between missions.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. PSN target 0/250. Stunt types and the 300-for-100% figure: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once — PlayStation tracks 0/9. Sample everything the game offers, one go at each: races, the shooting range, fishing, the arcade, bowling, meditation and the rest. The counter on this trophy shows how many types you have tried; use it to find the one you skipped.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. PSN target 0/9.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges — PlayStation tracks 0/42. There should be two shooting ranges sharing the 42 medals between them. Gold medals need accuracy and speed, so learn one range's drills, repeat them until each medal is gold, and use the counter to see how many are left.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. PSN target 0/42. Two ranges sharing 42 medals: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026 (not yet confirmed in-game by this guide).

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations — PlayStation tracks 0/14. One win per location is enough; you do not need to win every race at a location, just one at each of the 14. Work through the map location by location and tick them off.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. PSN target 0/14. 14 locations: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — PlayStation tracks 0/20. Different matters: winning the same race twice counts once. Try every race type the game offers and keep a note of which you have won; the counter climbs only on a first win.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. PSN target 0/20.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing challenge, fish it, and finish ahead of him. Fishing is one of the nine activity types, so this also feeds Master of None.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. No outside method needed.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Pick the shortest arcade game you find and play it through to the end — one completion is all it takes. No score target is named in the official description.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. No outside method needed.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's strand is a side story: follow his missions to the last one and finish it. Side-story finales stay open after the main story ends, so there is no rush — but finish the strand before you call the platinum done. Andy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. Finales stay open after the story; Andy excluded from Strangers & Freaks: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton's strand is a side story: follow his missions to the last one and finish it. Side-story finales stay open after the main story ends, so there is no rush — but finish the strand before you call the platinum done.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. Finales stay open after the story: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy's strand is a side story: follow his missions to the last one and finish it. Side-story finales stay open after the main story ends, so there is no rush — but finish the strand before you call the platinum done. Billy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. Finales stay open after the story; Billy excluded from Strangers & Freaks: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida — PlayStation tracks 0/8. Only some optional questlines count: Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's have their own trophies and do not count, so check the trophy counter after each strand you finish. Time-sensitive: the Chapter 3 race 'Race Against Yago' in Yago's street-racing strand carries an hourglass icon and counts here — save first, then race the moment it appears.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. PSN target 0/8. Excluded strands and the Yago race warning: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy's strand is a side story: follow his missions to the last one and finish it. Side-story finales stay open after the main story ends, so there is no rush — but finish the strand before you call the platinum done.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. Finales stay open after the story: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's strand is a side story: follow his missions to the last one and finish it. Side-story finales stay open after the main story ends, so there is no rush — but finish the strand before you call the platinum done. Tyrone's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. Finales stay open after the story; Tyrone excluded from Strangers & Freaks: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 in all (PlayStation tracks 0/18). Meditation spots show as purple icons when you are close, and each outdoor spot counts twice if you meditate there with both characters, so bring your partner. THE MISSABLE ONE: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 disappears after that chapter. After Lucia is home, check the kitchen in the morning (a morning after the mission Down to Earth is the usual time), follow her to the balcony of Jason's house and accept the optional task. It is not confirmed that the trophy strictly needs it, so do it anyway and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. PSN target 0/18. Purple icons, partner counting twice, and the Chapter 1 balcony warning: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026 (launch-day guide; the strict-need question is unconfirmed).

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel's hunting questline is Jason-only and sends you after animals through target decks; a clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine. Follow Bret's strand to the unique animal and take the clean shot.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. Jason-only questline, target decks, clean-shot advice: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets — PlayStation tracks 0/3. Collect cards across Leonida and finish three full sets. Cards are a collectible grind, so pick them up as you explore rather than leaving them all for the end.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. PSN target 0/3.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations — PlayStation tracks 0/100. Use the WAiNK app at 100 different spots. Scanning a vehicle with WAiNK also counts as discovering it for Whip It Good, so scan traffic as you drive and the two trophies climb together.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. PSN target 0/100. WAiNK scanning also counts for Whip It Good: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges — PlayStation tracks 0/50. Challenges are listed under Progress, then Challenges; the 100% checklist wants 70 of the 80, and many complete on their own while you play. Play normally, check the list, then mop up the easy ones left.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. PSN target 0/50. Challenge list location and the 70-of-80 figure: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Call your partner in, build a 4-star wanted level, then break line of sight and leave the red heat zone — the trophy pops once you have escaped, not while you are still hiding. Bank-vault jobs give you 4 stars straight away, so this pairs naturally with Maximum Withdrawal.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. Escape timing and the vault pairing: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Call your partner, then rob three shops in a row while the police are still chasing you — if the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone, the chain breaks. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to pop after you leave the third shop, so give it a moment before hitting a fourth.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. Chain-break rule and the 30-second delay: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — PlayStation tracks 0/100. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive. The 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning past 100.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. PSN target 0/100. WAiNK scanning and the 200-of-277 figure: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-motion aim — press L3 and R3 while aiming. Pick a group of gang enemies, such as the guards at an illegal operation, and use an assault rifle; Adrenaline extends Focus. Five down before Focus ends.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. Combat Focus controls and method: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. At Vice City International Airport, steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge — planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count; the planes at gates E3 and E4 work. Get to the cockpit, back out toward the runway and take off; fly about 1 km from the airport and the trophy pops (it is delayed). Save first — the police come fast.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. Gates E3/E4 and the 1 km delay: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026 (launch-day guide, not yet confirmed in-game by this guide).

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos — get into a military tank. Tanks should be parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far south-west of the map. Save first, get in, and drive and fire until it pops. This guide has not confirmed the location in-game; it is reported by the cited guide only.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. Tank location: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026 (reported only, not yet confirmed in-game).

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry-store robberies. Use the Snap Gun on a store's locked back door — kicking it in sets off the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, and leave without being seen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target; if someone spots you, reload rather than push on.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. Snap Gun, safe-code note and target store: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape — PlayStation tracks 0/5. Bank vaults unlock through That's Where The Money Is, an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4: tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open. You cannot carry all the bags alone, so bring your partner. The 100% checklist needs all eight vaults. Escaping one with your partner also earns Hot Together.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. PSN target 0/5. Vault unlock mission and the eight-vault figure: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Tail an armored truck, rob it, and escape the heat — the trophy pops once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area. Bring your partner: vault jobs pair with this one, and the escape is the hard part, not the robbery.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. Escape timing: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — all 52 areas (PlayStation tracks 0/52). Visit every area on the map; the counter climbs as new areas register. Drive, fly and sail the edges of the map at the end of your playthrough and the last few areas will fill in.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. PSN target 0/52.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — one for each of the 9 gangs (PlayStation tracks 0/9). The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations, so this pops along the way. Check the counter after each robbery to see which gangs are still missing.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. PSN target 0/9. 39 operations for 100%: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and take in the view. A quiet moment trophy — no combat, no timer, and no missable window stated in the official description.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. No outside method needed.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive into a vehicle showroom and smash your way back out through the front — the official description's 'in classic style' is a nod to the series' old showroom escapes. No location is pinned down in the official description, so any showroom that lets you drive out through it should count; this guide has not confirmed one in-game.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. No location pinned down in the official description; method unconfirmed in-game.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. The alley is Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation you visit in Chapter 2: bring Sticky Bombs, take all three key valuables — the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the contents of the office safe, blown open with a Sticky Bomb — then escape the police. If you leave something behind, the operation comes back later, so it is not missable.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. Kingpin Bowling details: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The cited guide reports it should pop when Jason and Lucia both reach maximum Strength — buy a gym membership and train with your partner there, since the partner trains alongside you. Not yet confirmed in-game by this guide; the official description names no method.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. Gym method: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026 (reported only, not yet confirmed in-game).

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse) — 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile (PlayStation tracks 0/500). Robberies and fights feed it, so it fills up without a separate grind. Play the crime-heavy parts of the list and check the counter late in the game.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. PSN target 0/500. Criminal Profile actions: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Fail something, then succeed on the second try — the official description gives no method, and this guide has not confirmed one in-game. It reads as a retry trophy: when you fail a challenge or mission step, try it again immediately rather than reloading an old save.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. Method not pinned down in the official description; unconfirmed in-game.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? A strange-encounter trophy — the official description gives no method, and no guide this entry checked pins one down yet. Keep playing and exploring; odd encounters across Leonida are the likely trigger, and this guide will not invent one.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. Method not pinned down anywhere this entry checked.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Strike someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — a drive-by with a melee weapon, not a gun. The official description gives no location; try it on a quiet road with a slow vehicle and a melee weapon equipped. Not yet confirmed in-game.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. Method not pinned down in the official description; unconfirmed in-game.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts — PlayStation tracks 0/250,000. Marked bills come from bank and payday-loan jobs and are laundered by selling them to your contacts; the $250,000 total is cumulative. Bank vaults and armored trucks feed it, so it climbs while you chase the robbery trophies.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. PSN target 0/250000. Marked-bill sources and cumulative total: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — PlayStation tracks 0/100,000. The total is cumulative across every kind of shop. Buy weapons, clothes, food and cars as you play; by the time you have bought the garages for Little Boxes, a good chunk of this is already done.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. PSN target 0/100000. Cumulative across all shops: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — 8 in all (PlayStation tracks 0/8). Buy the eight garages in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver; together they cost about $160,000. Garages the story gives you do not count, so buy all eight from the app.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. PSN target 0/8. App, unlock mission and total cost: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app — PlayStation tracks 0/10. The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the Scooter Bros app: take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first and register cheap cars.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. PSN target 0/10. Moses unlock and Pay 'n' Spray route: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.
